status: Kinematic and force comparison, not a finished mount or fabrication release

parts.basis: 62 mm at 150 g/m; NS-01-17 reference, end tolerance and mounting-hole placement must be specified
NW-02-17 standard, not preloaded; mounting boss and anti-rotation connection remain to detail
Historical KGLM-03: ID3 / OD10 / width6 mm; current LC successor is not presumed interchangeable
Short flat metal backings and offset connection to P carrier; joint design incomplete
20 mm offset bracket, captured bearing cage and keyed carriage attachment; actual volume unresolved
Smooth 3 mm pivots; left axially located, right floats 1 mm; thread/bearing and roller-end clearance unresolved
Rail, backing, cage and interface fastening; no print-thread-only retention
Unequal left/right upward preload; 0.03 N/mm each is a design target, not a selected spring
Positive captive slide stops and pitch stops; no friction-only flight restraint
Two spring-engaged catches plus pitch locator; station raises/releases head; not yet designed
Independent raised/captured feedback; no implemented controller logic
Local completion reserve; service-face supports remain in P and flex in existing plumbing

policy: Compare this whole local mechanism against P remaining compliance 35 g plus M lift 62 g, not against 35 g alone. Keep the 70 g P carrier, 135 g head frame, 75 g plumbing and all other assembly budgets. No savings booked before missing joints/capture, flex and threshold behavior close. Dock-only release cannot provide arbitrary airborne head repositioning.
